c74object.name: bachmcp.translate
c74object.digest: Convert scores between bach and dictionaries
c74object.description: Converts a bach.roll score to a dictionary (bachjson) and back, without losing anything. The dictionary has an optional header (clefs, keys, voicenames, markers, slotinfo...) and voices > chords (onset, notes) > notes (pitch, dur, vel, and optionally breakpoints, slots, articulations, name, flag). Times in ms, pitches in midicents (6000 = middle C). Full specification: bachjson-syntax-specification.md.

outlet.digest: Score in the @to format, or a message passed through (@transparent 1)

method.name: llll
method.description: A score in bach.roll's gathered syntax, when from is llll or t.

method.name: dictionary
method.description: A score as a dictionary, when from is json.

method.name: anything
method.description: With transparent 1, any message that is not a native llll or dictionary <name> goes out of the outlet unchanged. With transparent 0 it is refused with an error. With from t every message is read as a text llll, so nothing is passed through.

attribute.name: from
attribute.description: llll: native bach llll. t: text llll. json: a dictionary.

attribute.name: to
attribute.description: json: a dictionary. llll: native bach llll. t: text llll.

attribute.name: transparent
attribute.description: 1 (default): messages that are not a native llll or a dictionary go out of the outlet unchanged. 0: only lllls and dictionaries are taken. With from t every message is a text llll, so nothing is passed through.
